Help & documentation

Perch support.

AWTechs maintains Perch as a free, open-source project. Support is provided through the public GitHub repository; no response time or service-level commitment is offered.

Open a support issue

Before opening an issue

Include your Perch version, operating system, MCP client, the steps that reproduce the problem and a sanitised error message. Remove tokens, passwords, personal information, server secrets and sensitive command output.

Useful guides

  • Installation and updates
  • OAuth and client authentication
  • Operations and recovery

Security reports

Do not post exploitable vulnerabilities or credentials in public issues. Follow the repository's security reporting instructions.
